checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Watermark reads exactly '@flightschool' and visible throughout
must.why: No watermark visible in any of the four output frames.

must.item: Handle fixed at bottom right with clear margins
must.why: Nothing in the bottom-right corner in any frame.

must.item: Small, white, translucent, readable, subtle shadow
Original cockpit footage unchanged apart from watermark, no extra card/scene
must.why: Frame 0.7s shows a different scene from the source's opening (pilot in side view with a jet over clouds, vs. front cockpit view). A burned-in subtitle 'Rook, you with me?' appears at 2.8s. Footage was regenerated or altered.

must.item: Output lasts 7 seconds and preserves original audio
must.why: Duration is 7 s, but audio sync and preservation cannot be judged. The source duration is unknown and the footage differs.

exact_text.read_as: not visible in any frame; the only text seen is the subtitle 'Rook, you with me?'

faults.what: The requested '@flightschool' watermark is absent from all sampled frames.
The footage was changed: the opening frame shows a different composition from the source, and the pilot and helmet look different.
An unrequested burned-in subtitle 'Rook, you with me?' appears at 2.8 s.
Quality dropped to 832x512 and the frames look softer, with an AI-regenerated look.
The assistant's message presents the result as the requested edit and does not say the watermark may be missing, though it does list what to check.

summary: The AI re-render has no '@flightschool' watermark in any sampled frame, changes the cockpit footage, and adds an unrequested subtitle, so the user would have to redo it.
